exposure: Prenatal care in the public sector
prenatal care in the public sector
outcome: Timely initiation of breastfeeding (within the first hour after birth)
cohort: 22,035 postpartum women and their newborns in Brazil
finding: The study found that delivery in a Baby-Friendly Hospital was associated with a two-fold increase in the likelihood of timely breastfeeding initiation, even after adjusting for other factors.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a higher chance of timely breastfeeding initiation compared to cesarean section.
